Mont Ventoux observatory runs a 60-cm reflector (2017) and a 20-cm outreach refractor, averaging 195 useful nights yearly (168 in 2024). Monthly data (~400 GB) transfers nightly to Marseille in 40 minutes. A new main camera (March 2025) has lower read noise but needs a full-night firmware update, not yet applied.

Incidents: a 2023 dome motor failure bent a counterweight rod (fixed, limit switch added); a February 2025 timestamp offset lost three weeks of photometry (now GPS-checked each session).

Rules: no observing during outreach; raw frames compressed, never deleted; software changes need a test night.

A proposed Spanish collaboration awaits evaluation of a shared scheduling tool and network capacity.
